_schema: CFL research registry. Machine-readable mirror of CFL_RESEARCH_STATE.md. null means not known or not applicable - never a placeholder for a value someone should have filled in with a guess.

experiments.hypothesis: Conditional on the vig-free closing totals market, PROP-0001 carries additional information about whether a 3-round UFC fight goes over a posted round total. H0: gamma = 0 and G_LL = 0. H1: G_LL > 0 out of sample.
experiments.economic_rationale: Round totals are a thinner market than the moneyline, quoted by fewer books and moved less often. If a duration model holds information the totals price has not absorbed, that is where it would show.
experiments.population: UFC fights scheduled for 3 rounds, not flagged main event or title fight at lock time, settling with a finish or decision. Five-round fights excluded permanently.
experiments.market_benchmark: median of per-book vig-free p_over across eligible books at the identical threshold, last non-live quote strictly before v_fight_start_best.start_at (v_prop_odds_closing_consensus)
experiments.prediction_time_rule: A lock must exist in prop_model_locks written before the fight's best-known start, enforced by an insert trigger. training_cutoff must precede actual_lock_at. The lock's actual_lock_at must not be after the latest closing quote.
experiments.primary_endpoint: G_LL = LL_baseline - LL_challenger, pooled out-of-sample log loss, walk-forward by event
eligibility_rules: UFC event, scheduled 3 rounds, not main event or title fight at lock time, actual scheduled rounds 3 once the result is in
a PROP-0001@v1 lock exists, written before the fight's best-known start
fight settles with a finish or decision; no-contests, overturned results and 'could not continue' are void
not a dead or duplicate booking
sportsbook threshold exactly equals a locked threshold (0.5, 1.5, 2.5); no interpolation or nearest-line mapping
at least one non-synthetic, non-live quote captured strictly before the fight's start
start basis is bell_at or provider_commence; event_date_fallback rows are diagnostics only
the lock's actual_lock_at is not after the latest closing quote
formal_analysis_points: no performance number is computed for a card until every eligible fight on it has settled
the first card (UFC 331) produces a descriptive table only; no decision is taken from one card
decision rules are evaluated only on the full accumulated sample
allowed_sensitivities: de-vig sensitivity: proportional, reported beside the primary power de-vig (amendment 1.1)
de-vig sensitivity: Shin (1993), reported beside the primary (amendment 1.1)
moved-provider-start split on the historical flag, zero credit cost (amendment 1.2)
secondary opener test (walk-forward OLS predicting logit(P_close) from logit(P_open) with and without logit(P_CFL)); not a decision input
raw comparison LL_market - LL_CFL, informational only
Brier, calibration intercept and slope of the challenger
forbidden_changes: retraining, re-featuring, re-calibrating or re-mapping PROP-0001 while the sample accumulates
selecting thresholds after results are visible
interpolating, extrapolating or nearest-line mapping a threshold
deriving 3.5 or 4.5 probabilities for five-round fights
writing any historical backfill into prop_model_locks
optimising ROI thresholds; CLV and ROI are reported as null
introducing any de-vig method beyond power (primary), proportional and Shin (sensitivities) - amendment 1.1
promoting a de-vig sensitivity to primary after any result is visible - amendment 1.1
excluding a fight from the historical cohort on a capture property; moved starts are flagged and retained - amendment 1.2
retaining the rejected self-consistent-walkback timing rule as a sensitivity - amendment 1.2

preregistration_amendments.title: De-vig method (item h) and historical timing rule (item i)

held_amendment_clauses.status: HELD - not approved en bloc; each requires an individual vote on its actual clause text
held_amendment_clauses.note: The calibration blocker is closed, which does not make the remaining clauses automatically sound. Any clause changing data eligibility, scoring, model behaviour or claim interpretation gets an individual vote; pure governance/monitoring clauses are lower risk.

first_collection.provenance: code_version is -dirty and the lock script was untracked at the time; see research/provenance/PROVENANCE_REPORT.md. Prediction provenance verified, source-code provenance incomplete.

experiments.population: UFC fights scheduled for 3 rounds, 2010 onward, clean finish or decision
experiments.prediction_time_rule: Training data is every completed 3-round UFC fight with event_date strictly before training_cutoff. Fighter histories use only rounds and fights strictly before that cutoff.
eligibility_rules: outcome classifies as finish or decision (no-contest and unparseable excluded)
formal_analysis_points: block walk-forward gate from 2018-01-01 in 6-month blocks, reported in cfl_engine/harness/walkforward_report.json
forbidden_changes: any change to features, model form, calibration recipe or threshold mapping without a new model_version and its own preregistration
editing any file listed in frozen_files in place
experiments.results_artifact_measures: the RAW hazard model, isotonic step bypassed - NOT the complete PROP-0001 locking pipeline. Established 2026-09-16, see research/provenance/CALIBRATION_FINDING.md and cfl_engine/harness/README.md.
experiments.historical_validation_scope: Historical walk-forward testing supports the underlying raw hazard model. The calibration layer used in live PROP-0001 forecasts was not validated by that historical artifact.

experiments.hypothesis: Conditional on the vig-free totals market, the UNCALIBRATED PROP-0001 hazard (PROP-0001@v2) carries additional information about whether a 3-round UFC fight goes over a posted round total.
experiments.economic_rationale: Same thin-market rationale as DUR-001. DUR-002 exists because the specification the historical gate artifact actually evaluated (raw hazard, no post-hoc calibration) has never been run prospectively, while the specification running prospectively has never been evaluated historically.
experiments.market_benchmark: inherited from DUR-001 section 6 as amended by Amendment 1.1: power de-vig primary, proportional and Shin as frozen sensitivities
experiments.prediction_time_rule: identical to DUR-001: lock written before the fight's best-known start, enforced by insert trigger; training_cutoff precedes actual_lock_at
experiments.primary_endpoint: G_LL = LL_baseline - LL_challenger, pooled out-of-sample log loss, walk-forward by event
eligibility_rules: inherited unchanged from DUR-001 sections 4 and 5, as amended by Amendment 1
formal_analysis_points: no number is computed until the preregistration is frozen and eligible fights have settled
experiments.kill_rule: checkpoint at the earlier of 2027-09-16 or 500 valid prospective observations; then HOLD-PASSIVE if not PROMOTE
allowed_sensitivities: de-vig sensitivities inherited from DUR-001 Amendment 1.1: proportional and Shin
forbidden_changes: reintroducing isotonic or any other post-hoc calibration to PROP-0001@v2
citing any historical performance figure for v2 as evidence for or against it
modifying PROP-0001@v1, its locks, or DUR-001's preregistration
writing a v2 backfill into prop_model_locks
comparing v1 and v2 head-to-head without a separate preregistration
any amendment motivated by an observed result
experiments.naming: DUR-002 is the EXPERIMENT; PROP-0001@v2 is the MODEL VERSION it tests. They are not interchangeable and must not be used as synonyms.
freeze_establishes: PROP-0001@v2 uses the raw hazard-derived probability; no isotonic or other post-hoc calibration is fitted, attached or consulted
the historical raw-vs-calibrated comparison was already observed and cannot be used as evidence for DUR-002
no parameter, eligibility rule, feature definition, timing rule, scoring rule or threshold may change after freeze without a formally versioned dated amendment
prospective observations after the freeze are authoritative even where they contradict the historical artifact
DUR-002 stays separate from PROP-0001@v1 forever: no retroactive regrading, no replacement of v1 probabilities, no migration of v1 rows

lock_script.role: Operational implementation of the already-frozen DUR-002 specification. Contains no modelling decisions. A thin wrapper: PITWorld, fit_prop0001, serve_fight, build_lock_rows, the loaders and the threshold mapping are all imported from the frozen lock_prop0001.py, which is neither modified nor copied. The only behavioural difference is model.iso_ = None, so every prediction is the raw hazard.
guards: MODEL_VERSION hard-coded to PROP-0001@v2; assert_v2_only aborts the run on any row carrying another version, checked twice including immediately before the insert
never updates, replaces or regrades a v1 row; no UPDATE or DELETE is ever attempted
refuses to write from a dirty working tree (git status --porcelain, so untracked files count) unless --allow-dirty, which records the tree-state hash on every row
every row records lock_prop0002.py's own sha256 in notes, so the implementation behind any v2 forecast is identifiable from the row alone
lock_script.note: Section 0.3 of the frozen preregistration says this script does not exist. That is a true statement about the state AT FREEZE and is deliberately not updated - the preregistration is not altered to reflect a file created after it was frozen. Current state lives here.

experiments.disclosure: The raw-vs-calibrated historical comparison was seen before drafting and favoured the uncalibrated variant. It is not the basis for the specification and may not be cited as evidence for it. See section 2 of the preregistration.

first_collection.procedure: On the successful first insert of a PROP-0001@v2 row, record here: the exact first-lock UTC timestamp, the workflow run id and commit SHA, lock_prop0002.py's sha256, and the number of rows written. Then set lock_script.frozen = true, move the script into frozen_files, change status from 'armed' to 'collecting', and rerun the full guards.
first_collection.expected_via: .github/workflows/prop-locks.yml, daily 11:00 UTC, as a separate step after the v1 lock step

definitions.draft: preregistration written but not signed; nothing frozen; no observation may be created
definitions.frozen: preregistration signed and binding; no operational implementation yet
definitions.armed: specification frozen AND implementation written, tested and wired, but ZERO observations recorded
definitions.collecting: at least one observation exists; the transition is the successful first insert, not a decision

experiment_lifecycle.note: armed exists because 'collecting' with zero rows overstates the state. The armed -> collecting transition is objective: it is the first row landing, not a judgement call.
